> I read this as Research - verify the claims in the prompt against Tests/main.swift, Tests/XCTests/CryptoProtocolTests.swift, E2ETests/main.swift, and project.yml.

<verdict>PASS</verdict>
<confidence>HIGH</confidence>
<summary>All claimed post-fix test improvements across Tests/main.swift, Tests/XCTests/CryptoProtocolTests.swift, and E2ETests/main.swift are verified directly in the codebase. The rewritten E2E test fully exercises the real security pipeline end-to-end (TLS-PSK bootstrap pairing, directional AES-GCM UDP key derivation, encrypted video streaming, and reassembly/decode). The remaining test gaps (TCP framing edge cases, UDP reordering/orphan reassembly, clipboard echo suppression, and TestCLI sleeps) are confirmed and prioritized.</summary>

<fix_verification>
- Tests/main.swift (TestCLI target): VERIFIED
  - 37 total tests (Tests/main.swift:31, 39, 45, 52, 64, 71, 84, 91, 98, 107, 114, 121, 128, 135, 142, 149, 155, 161, 168, 174, 181, 187, 196, 219, 242, 273, 286, 298, 326, 372, 392, 415, 434, 442, 461, 584, 627)
  - STUN honest failure on error: VERIFIED (Tests/main.swift:274-279)
  - VideoEncoder asserts callback fired: VERIFIED (Tests/main.swift:328, 359-362)
  - VideoDecoder asserts garbage produces no decoded frames: VERIFIED (Tests/main.swift:374-386)
  - InputReceiver gated on AXIsProcessTrusted with single mouse-move injection: VERIFIED (Tests/main.swift:444-456)
  - VideoEncoder -> VideoDecoder requires actual decode (decodedPixelBuffer != nil): VERIFIED (Tests/main.swift:463-547)
  - NEW Test 15 (TLS-PSK encrypted loopback channel): VERIFIED (Tests/main.swift:553-603)
  - NEW Test 16 (UDP 20-datagram burst delivery): VERIFIED (Tests/main.swift:608-632)

- Tests/XCTests/CryptoProtocolTests.swift (EclipticRDLogicTests target): VERIFIED
  - HKDF RFC 5869 test vectors A.1 & A.3: VERIFIED (Tests/XCTests/CryptoProtocolTests.swift:6-27)
  - DatagramCipher roundtrip, tamper, AAD mismatch, duplicate replay, stale-window, direction-keys: VERIFIED (Tests/XCTests/CryptoProtocolTests.swift:38-83)
  - PacketHeader truncation and unknown type rejection: VERIFIED (Tests/XCTests/CryptoProtocolTests.swift:86-96)
  - FrameHeaderPayload bounds (totalSize > 32MiB, maxChunks): VERIFIED (Tests/XCTests/CryptoProtocolTests.swift:98-109)
  - HandshakePayload v3 roundtrip and tail-tolerance: VERIFIED (Tests/XCTests/CryptoProtocolTests.swift:111-128)
  - PairingPayload roundtrips and wrong key-length rejection: VERIFIED (Tests/XCTests/CryptoProtocolTests.swift:140-157)
  - PairingStore Keychain save/load/delete roundtrip: VERIFIED (Tests/XCTests/CryptoProtocolTests.swift:159-165)
  - Bootstrap lockout after 5 consecutive failures: VERIFIED (Tests/XCTests/CryptoProtocolTests.swift:167-178)

- E2ETests/main.swift (E2ETest tool): VERIFIED
  - Drives ServerCore.makeForTesting(frameSource:) with SyntheticFrameSource: VERIFIED (E2ETests/main.swift:24-82, 89)
  - Full loopback TLS-PSK bootstrap pairing flow (PIN generation -> pairing request -> consent -> grant): VERIFIED (E2ETests/main.swift:98-120)
  - Asserts pairing grant persisted in client PairingManager: VERIFIED (E2ETests/main.swift:122)
  - Asserts onSessionReady signaled over TLS-PSK: VERIFIED (E2ETests/main.swift:120)
  - Asserts >= 10 synthetic frames assembled and decoded at usable FPS (>= 10 FPS): VERIFIED (E2ETests/main.swift:136-137)
  - Clean server and client teardown: VERIFIED (E2ETests/main.swift:143-147)
  - Security path verification: VERIFIED (Bootstrap TLS-PSK -> in-band pairing grant -> Handshake v3 session salt -> directional UDP DatagramCipher derive -> AES-GCM encrypted/decrypted video chunking and frame decoding)
</fix_verification>

<remaining_gaps>
1. TCP Stream Coalescing & Fragmentation Unit Tests: `TCPChannel.processBuffer` contains 4-byte length-prefix buffering and slicing logic, but is not unit-tested with fragmented byte streams (partial length headers, split payloads) or coalesced frames (multiple frames in one socket read).
2. UDP Out-of-Order / Orphan Chunks Reassembly Unit Tests: `FrameReceiver` implements orphan chunk buffering for datagrams arriving prior to the `FrameHeaderPayload`, but existing tests only feed chunks in strict sequence after the header.
3. Clipboard Echo & Concealed Type Suppression Unit Tests: `ClipboardMonitor` changeCount-based echo suppression, content hash deduplication, and concealed/transient type filtering lack automated tests.
4. Deterministic Synchronization in TestCLI: `Tests/main.swift` uses fixed `Thread.sleep` delays (200-500ms) for socket binding and handshake readiness rather than semaphores or condition variables.
5. Audio Frame Fragmentation & In-Band Playback: `ClientCore.handleAudioPayload` multi-chunk audio frame reassembly and playback routing are untested outside header serialization.
</remaining_gaps>
